items.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
items.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

items.summary: An MIT expert committee warns that AI is eroding key parts of the college experience: office hours, study groups, and the school's flagship research program for undergraduates are all fading. Trust between faculty and students is breaking down, and some professors are even considering AI agents instead of students as research assistants. The university most closely tied to AI's origin story is now calling for a complete overhaul of higher education. The article AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 麻省理工學院（MIT）專家委員會警告，AI 正在侵蝕大學體驗的關鍵部分：辦公時間、讀書會以及該校的標誌性大學生研究計畫都在逐漸消失。教職員與學生之間的信任正在瓦解，部分教授甚至考慮使用 AI 代理而非學生擔任研究助理。這所與 AI 起源故事最緊密相連的大學，現在正呼籲對高等教育進行全面改革。這篇題為「MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
items.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items_ai.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items_ai.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
items_ai.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。
